    Estimated total · 1 bedroom

    Checkout shows the room subtotal, any coupon discount, applicable 12% VAT, and the total due. Online payment uses PayMongo; payment processing fees are not added to your total.

    Pay securely through PayMongo. After payment, show the payment reference in Reservation History at the counter; staff must verify it before the reservation is marked paid. Rooms are held for 30 minutes.

    Room availability is limited. An unpaid reservation holds inventory temporarily; confirmed payments keep the rooms for the booked dates.

    CEBUSTAYS DIRECTIONS

    Hotel location

    Map tiles are unavailable. You can still use the directions details.

    Your location is requested only after you choose an access option. To calculate directions, your coordinates are sent to OSRM; the map provider also receives the visible map area. CebuStays does not store your coordinates. Entered starting places go to OpenStreetMap's geocoder. External providers process requests under their own privacy policies.
